calls.title: Weekly 1:1 Elyse/Ashley
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around a competitive pricing analysis highlighting trends in usage-based fees and modular add-ons. It revealed that seven out of ten competitors employ add-ons, often tied to enterprise packages, while PostHog opts for a simpler usage-based model aimed at smaller customers. Additionally, LaunchDarkly showcases a tiered structure emphasizing MAUs and various features for enterprise users. The meeting identified the necessity for clearer packaging to improve upgrade incentives, especially between free and pro tiers, alongside the need for consolidated sales enablement materials to assist sales reps. Participants highlighted the ongoing collaboration required to refine communication around pricing transparency and feature accessibility.
